signature: Level 1's concrete warehouse swallowed by a garden: grass and flowers of every colour between the huge pillars, vines up every column and across the ceiling, a batch of sunflowers under a live tube, ancient stone ruins and abandoned camps, and pollen that carries the memories of the people the garden has already taken.

exits.label: Walked back out of the Concrete Garden into the bare concrete halls
exits.hint: The way out is the way in: the concrete hall where the grass thins out.

fail_states.label: Became part of the Concrete Garden (Bloom reached 100 %)
fail_states.source_quote: progressively turning you into a plant like many others in the past

entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE. Entities avoid the garden; nothing is spawned. The Curabitur Bird and the Leaders operative appear only as pollen memories (captions).
notes: SOURCE: sub-sector of Scene 01.3 with Level 1's layout plus heavy vegetation (tall grass and multicoloured flowers on the floor; vines on pillars and walls, sometimes across the ceiling); no entities; settlers never heard from again; an hour inside starts turning you into a plant. TESTIMONY: concrete floor giving way to crunchy grass; fresh air; plants of contradicting climates with no sun or soil; ruins of settlements, some far too ancient for wanderers; fragile stone fences; bluebonnet pollen memories (togas and birds; a Leaders operative rooted to the ground); the level taking the visitor's memories (sunflowers as anchor); a rose through the leg, muscles failing; labyrinthine layout. ADAPTATION: a 64 x 80 m garden behind a 24 m concrete hall (the page gives no size); the terrace (+1.2 m), lookout (+2.4 m) and sunken bay (-1.2 m) are natural variation, not page facts; partition-wall openings and rubble are seeded; the compressed hour (4 min) and Bloom rate (7 min to full); pollen adds 5 %; Bloom stages and the notebook text are paraphrases of the story beats. The rescue to Base Alpha (L001_2>EXT#2) and death by transformation (L001_2>EXT#3) are not exits: the latter is the fail state. Not built: Olivia, Megan or Tournesol as characters; Level 1.1 / 1.3 links (link list only).
